subject: science
domain: Heredity: Inheritance and Variation of Traits
intro: In asexual reproduction, one parent produces offspring that are genetically identical to the parent (clones). In sexual reproduction, two parents each contribute genetic material, so offspring have a new combination of genes and show genetic variation. Variation means offspring differ from each other and from their parents. Asexual reproduction is fast and preserves a successful genotype; sexual reproduction creates variation that can help a population survive changing conditions.

items.prompt: A strawberry plant sends out runners that grow into new plants identical to it. Is this asexual or sexual reproduction, and are the offspring varied?

steps: One parent produces the new plants, which are identical to it.
One parent and identical offspring indicate asexual reproduction.
Identical offspring means no genetic variation.
solution.answer: Asexual reproduction; the offspring are genetically identical (no variation).

items.prompt: Two dogs produce a litter of puppies that look different from each other. Explain why using the type of reproduction.

steps: Two parents each contributed genetic material, so this is sexual reproduction.
The offspring get new combinations of genes.
New combinations produce genetic variation, so the puppies differ.
solution.answer: Sexual reproduction mixes two parents' genes, producing varied offspring.

items.prompt: Why might genetic variation from sexual reproduction help a population survive a new disease?

steps: Variation means individuals differ in their traits.
Some individuals may happen to resist the disease.
Those survivors can reproduce, helping the population survive.
solution.answer: Because varied individuals are more likely to include some that can resist the disease.

items.prompt: How many parents are involved in asexual reproduction?
Do offspring from sexual reproduction show variation?

steps: Yes, sexual reproduction produces offspring with genetic variation.
Genetically identical means the offspring have the same genes as the parent.
solution.answer: Having the same genes as the parent.
